# Stratum Cost Segregation
> Engineering-based cost segregation studies and educational resources for rental property owners, including STRs, Airbnb and vacation rentals.

Stratum is a service provider. Its comparisons and buyer guides are provider-authored, not independent rankings. A study supports property component analysis; the owner’s tax preparer determines eligibility, elections, loss limitations and implementation. No deduction or savings is guaranteed.

## Study scope and pricing
- STR and Airbnb studies: https://www.stratumcostsegregation.com/short-term-rental-cost-segregation/
- Pricing ($1 per square foot, $2,000 minimum per property): https://www.stratumcostsegregation.com/pricing/
- Discovery: https://www.stratumcostsegregation.com/cost-seg-discovery/
- Study standards: https://www.stratumcostsegregation.com/reviews/
